_comment: Shared typography tier vectors. Read by coui_core (CoreTypography.atTier,
CoreBreakpoint.forWidth and the Figma token export), coui_flutter (the
text the theme draws at each viewport width) and coui_web (the variables
the stylesheet restates per tier) tests, so a tier that drifts on one
platform fails against the same numbers the others produce.
Written by hand, not generated: a table read back from the code it checks
cannot fail when that code is wrong.
roles: the size (logical px) and tracking (em) each role draws at under
CoreTypography.coui in each tier. The six heading roles step down below
desktop — display 8px per tier, headline 4px — and the mobile
headline-small, at 16px, tracks on the step below 20px. title-large,
body-medium and code-sm stand for the roles that keep one size at every
widths: the tier a viewport width in logical px resolves to. 768 and 1024
